name: duopore-public-property-maintenance-scenario
description: Compare low, middle and high maintenance cost plans using your own estimates.

interface.longDescription: Compare low, middle and high maintenance cost plans using your own estimates. Enter the work items, amounts, unit costs, spare budget and the factors for each plan. See how the total changes. Use it to plan which quotes or figures still need checking. These are your cost scenarios, not contractor quotes or a property valuation.
defaultPrompt: Compare low, base and high maintenance budgets from these estimates.
How does my maintenance budget change with these cost factors?
